subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should WhatsApp support only explicitly requested, sticker-ready WebP delivery first, or should OpenClaw also convert arbitrary images into WhatsApp-compliant stickers?
rationale: The transport route is bounded, but conversion changes media ownership, format guarantees, animated-sticker support, and dependency expectations that cannot be selected safely from issue discussion alone.

options.title: Explicit sticker-ready delivery
options.body: Add a documented WhatsApp sticker intent that routes caller-provided compliant WebP media to Baileys without automatic conversion.

options.title: Own conversion
options.body: Accept broader image inputs and add a maintained conversion and validation pipeline for static and animated WhatsApp stickers.

recommendation.title: Explicit sticker-ready delivery
recommendation.body: Add a documented WhatsApp sticker intent that routes caller-provided compliant WebP media to Baileys without automatic conversion.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership of the WhatsApp send and shared-media path makes this the strongest available routing candidate.
